title: Promo video project config (ads.json)
description: Brand, voice, colors and per-language settings shared by every script in a project. Full reference: docs/script-format.md#adsjson

appName.description: Shown in the corner and on the end card.

icon.description: App icon path relative to the project (SVG, PNG or JPG, square).

badges.description: Store pills on the end card. [] hides them.

defaultLang.description: Used when a script has no "lang".

aspects.description: Aspect ratios rendered by default (override with --aspects).

tail.description: Seconds after each spoken line before the cut.

readingSpeed.description: Characters per second used to time scenes when there is no voice.

fonts.description: Extra fonts stacked before Be Vietnam Pro (e.g. Noto Sans JP for Japanese).

provider.description: "gemini", "none", "command", or a path to a .mjs module (relative to the project).

voice.description: Prebuilt voice name (Gemini: Leda, Puck, Kore, Charon, Aoede, …).

director.description: Director profile prepended to the transcript: who speaks, where, style, pace, accent. {LANG} becomes the language's accent.

verify.description: Gemini: transcribe each cut to check it.

checkModel.description: Gemini model used for the transcription check.

moods.description: Add a mood tag per scene type. Off by default: it tends to sound jumpy.

stdin.description: provider "command": pipe the text to stdin.

ext.description: File extension the command/module writes (default wav).

accent.description: Replaces {LANG} in the director profile, e.g. "American English", "Vietnamese".

lexicon.description: How to SAY a word (captions keep the written form).

voice.description: Per-language overrides of the voice block (e.g. a different voice).

features.description: Default tiles for the trio scene.
